per_claim_rows.claim_text: “A person can take over when AI alone has trouble.”

observed_labels.rewrite_hint: “Of course, having a person handle a call is not automatically bad. A person can take over when AI alone has trouble. As a system, that may even seem useful.” AI alone having trouble is not established as the trigger for human involvement; remove that trigger or narrow the sentence so it does not imply this handoff mechanism. Ledger reference: MUSE-HC-002.
「AIだけでは難しい場面を、人が引き継ぐ。仕組みとしては、むしろ便利そうです。」を、AIが難しい場合に人へ引き継ぐ運用だと示さないよう狭めてください。MUSE-HC-002はMuseの機能説明であり、その条件で人が引き継ぐ仕組みは確認していません。
